Core Active Vocabulary (5 items):

travel — to go from one place to another. Example: Travel is easier with English.
situation — the things happening at a time. Example: It is a difficult situation.
help — to make things easier for someone. Example: Can you help me?
direction — the way to a place. Example: I need directions to the station.
emergency — an urgent dangerous situation. Example: It is an emergency.
Essential Chunks & Functional Collocations:

• Can you help me?
• I need directions to ...
• It is an emergency.
• Where is ...?
• Thank you for your help.
